tool: @napi-rs/canvas with drawCinematicFrameV188 production renderer and exact selected repository PNGs
inspectedRevision: Working tree over baseCommit; exact source hashes are authoritative

fixture.images: Native decoded PNGs injected into the existing images object. No generated source pixels are altered.
fixture.decoding: Native file-path decoding. The installed binding rejects PNG Buffers as Invalid SVG image while successfully decoding the identical file by path. No source conversion, raster rewrite or image derivation is used.

fonts.families: Production generic monospace and sans-serif resolve to DejaVu Sans Mono and DejaVu Sans, registered in normal/bold before any Canvas is created.

fixture.glyphAudit: Final opaque speaker names, complete dialogue subtitles and captions are audited at tolerance2. Decorative portrait initials are excluded: the existing radio static deliberately overlays them. REC is audited separately with the same pixel threshold.
fixture.timeline: Actual 11 production shots. Sample at 82% of each shot, after typewriter completion and before fade-out.
fixture.fallback: Identical production call with an empty images object.
fixture.baseline: Production story/station sources from cd44257822a649a7532eec5a70d60f6663640a77 with unchanged dependencies.
fixture.limits: No Chromium page, network load, keyboard traversal, combat, save or reward journey. Native Canvas raster differs from browser text rendering.

independentLoadingReview.scope: Read-only tracing of production renderer, preload and DOM-player lifecycle. Canvas/DOM/Image/RAF are explicit test doubles. This is not a browser, network, image decoding or visual QA claim.

limitations.observation: An Image that fails permanently remains cached as a failed object by CinematicPlayer; replay uses fallback without retrying the URL. The same preload deduplication existed at the baseline. Delayed successful loads do redraw correctly.
